english_text: We have the head of Xanthippus!
The dog, Caesar, is dead at last!
czech_text: Ten pes Caesar je konečně mrtev!
tts_text_override: Ten pes Cézar je konečně mrtev!
override_reason: Caesar: Czech convention [cézar]; TTS may read the Latin spelling as ka-e-sar
Miltiadés: hard t in the Greek name (use only if the pilot palatalizes ti)
Germanicus: Latin c = [k] and hard n; Czech TTS would read [germaňicus]
Massinissa: hard n (use only if the pilot palatalizes ni)
Arminius: hard n (use only if the pilot palatalizes ni)
Leonidas: hard d (use only if the pilot palatalizes di)
